dict.string: The Lanaar are a heavily shielded energy race, with quick response time. Shield damaging weapons will be most effective.

The Cykans are a cybernetic race with good all-around fighters and defense. Balanced weapons will be most effective.
Crates in this system are protected by armed guards. Watch out for the planet -- its gravity will suck you in.
Each crate contains a weapon. Watch out for mines that explode when you get too close. Look for the blinking red light!
Fly to the crate and destroy it. It might have something useful in it.
The Wrethk are a versatile organic race, utilizing heavy firepower with fragile ships. Balanced weapons will be most effective.
Nebulas affect enemy ships, too. A red nebula may be used to your advantage.
Ship feeling sluggish? Watch the mass of your ship and weapons. Lighter ships and weapons will be more agile.
